name: Money Mod
description: Adds a price to every editor object. Start with a budget, spend it as you build, and get locked out of placing once you're broke.

starting-money.name: Starting Money
starting-money.description: How much money you start with each time you open the editor

default-object-price.name: Default Object Price
default-object-price.description: Price charged for any object that isn't in the custom price list

persist-money.name: Persist Money Between Sessions
persist-money.description: If on, money carries over between editor sessions instead of resetting to Starting Money each time
